📢 Employee Referral | Walk-in Drive – Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) | Mohali

Hi Team,

We're hiring Consultants – Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) for our Mohali office on a 1.5-month contractual assignment.

Eligibility:
• LLB Graduates (Freshers)
• Candidates with prior Document Review (DR) or Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) experience will be preferred.
• Immediate joiners only (must be available to join by 6 August 2026)

Walk-in Details:
29 July – 31 July 2026
10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Venue: EXO Edge, Office No. A010/11, Ground Floor, Tower A, Bestech Business Towers, Sector 66, Mohali – 160066
Google Maps: https://lnkd.in/gjMhTzqB

If you know anyone who fits the above criteria, please encourage them to attend the walk-in drive directly.

Referral Process (Mandatory):
To ensure your referral is considered under the Employee Referral Program, please share the candidate's profile from your official EXO Edge email ID to hiring@exoedge.com before the candidate's HR interaction. As per the referral policy, profiles submitted directly by candidates will not be eligible as employee referrals.

Your referrals can make a difference—thank you for your support!

If anyone interested can send me your resume on my WhatsApp 7078307465.
comment: CLM roles are a strong entry point for law graduates, but candidates should also focus on process discipline and contract data accuracy since those skills often determine long-term growth in this space.
